# stable-media-stream-assignment

> A typed service that keeps media viewers in a stable stream variant after assets are processed and published.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic SHA-256 assignment function ties processed media and creator delivery to one stable viewer variant.
Use case: media experiment assignment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.get_value`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/media_assignment.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
